Frequently Asked Questions

What size mini split do I need for 200 sq ft (Standard Insulated Room (8 ft Ceiling))?

For 200 sq ft with an 8-foot ceiling under Standard Insulated Room (8 ft Ceiling) conditions, the calculated cooling load is 4,400 BTU/hr, requiring a 6,000 BTU (0.5-Ton) inverter mini-split.

What breaker and wire size does a 6,000 BTU mini split require?

A 6,000 BTU condenser typically operates on 115V or 208/230V power with a 15A circuit breaker and 14 AWG Copper (12 AWG rec.) copper wiring. Always confirm the exact MCA and MOP on the outdoor unit nameplate.

How much does it cost per month to run a mini split in a 200 sq ft room?

At 20 SEER2 and $0.16/kWh, a 6,000 BTU variable-inverter mini-split averages ~$17/month during peak summer months (~$33/year).
